notes.title: Support us on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As you know, Ballads at Midnight is completely free, so if you want to support the team behind we are currently running a Kickstater campaign for Imperial Grace, a game made by the same direct and lead artist. Also, our trailer is voiced by the delicious Eric Navarro (Lucius voice actor) check it out <3

[previewyoutube=LpaHlBWXFUI;full][/previewyoutube]

There are only three days left to complete the final stretch goals so don't delay! Also, if you can’t support financially but still want to spread the word, we have some cool community goals! Every post count! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42455891/d24e8bc8f9efae0c5133d4e7ad8286fbefe43384.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652580/Imperial_Grace/


I also encourage you to check out the work of the other members of the team if you haven’t already: 

- Download the soundtrack of the game on any music store.
- Play Herotome (Demo on itchio), the main game of our lead writer, Wudge.
- Play Perfumare (itchio) another super cool game proofread by the wonderful Jen
- Play the lovely Where are you Cinderella (demo on itchio), by Kimi, our trailer maker.


Anyway, thank you so much for all the love you have showed to Ballads at Midnight so far, I can't believe after less than a year we have 240 reviews, and more than 50 000 downloads!!! THANK YOU! 

It’s unlikely the game will ever receive any update because the original team is busy with others project, but I want to celebrate the first years anniversary, so I am planning some surprise for the 15th July, stay tuned! 

Take care, 
Ayael
